name: M. Varn
description: A clerk of the Board. Grey gloves, kept on.

visits.greeting: Good morning, curator. A writ from the Board.

request.text: Common Wards and Small Mendings. Today, if you please.

readThoughts.default: Back by the noon bell. Don't read it on the way.

purpose.0: The writ is all the explanation required.

knowledge.0: More than you, I expect. No offence meant.

source.0: The Board keeps a catalogue of its own.

experience.0: I'm a clerk, curator. I carry things.

lent.line: The Board thanks you. It will be returned.
